text: Universities should replace most timed exams with project-based assessment.
Large cities should make public transport free at the point of use.
Social platforms should hide public engagement counts.
A four-day workweek should become the default for office jobs.
Schools should prohibit personal smartphones during the school day.
Museums should return artifacts acquired under colonial rule.
Debate competitions should reward changing one’s mind when the evidence warrants it.
Governments should prioritize repairing infrastructure over building new projects.
